# cmake/CMakeLists.txt -- AUTO-GENERATED by `tur fetch`. Do not edit.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(SpiceDeps)

include(FetchContent)

option(TUR_FETCH_FORCE_FETCH "Bypass system find_package for :prefer-system deps" OFF)

# glfw
FetchContent_Declare(glfw
  GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/glfw/glfw
  GIT_TAG        3.4
)
set(GLFW_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GLFW_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GLFW_BUILD_DOCS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GLFW_BUILD_WAYLAND OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(glfw)
set(_glfw_resolved_via "fetch" CACHE INTERNAL "")

# glad
FetchContent_Declare(glad
  GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad
  GIT_TAG        v2.0.6
)
set(GLAD_SOURCES_DIR . CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GLAD_PROFILE core CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GLAD_API gl:core=3.3 CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(glad)
set(_glad_resolved_via "fetch" CACHE INTERNAL "")

# --- Generate spice-deps-manifest.json ---
set(_spice_manifest_path "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/spice-deps-manifest.json")
set(_spice_manifest "{\n")
set(_spice_first TRUE)

# manifest entry: glfw
if(NOT _spice_first)
  string(APPEND _spice_manifest ",\n")
endif()
set(_spice_first FALSE)
FetchContent_GetProperties(glfw)
if(EXISTS "${glfw_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
  set(_spice_glfw_inc "${glfw_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
else()
  set(_spice_glfw_inc "${glfw_SOURCE_DIR}")
endif()
set(_spice_glfw_bld "${glfw_BINARY_DIR}")
string(APPEND _spice_manifest
  "  \"glfw\": {\n"
  "    \"resolved_via\": \"${_glfw_resolved_via}\",\n"
)
string(APPEND _spice_manifest
  "    \"include_dirs\": [\"${_spice_glfw_inc}\"],\n"
  "    \"link_dirs\":    [\"${_spice_glfw_bld}\"],\n"
  "    \"link_libs\":    [\"glfw\"]\n"
)
string(APPEND _spice_manifest "  }")

# manifest entry: glad
if(NOT _spice_first)
  string(APPEND _spice_manifest ",\n")
endif()
set(_spice_first FALSE)
FetchContent_GetProperties(glad)
if(EXISTS "${glad_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
  set(_spice_glad_inc "${glad_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
else()
  set(_spice_glad_inc "${glad_SOURCE_DIR}")
endif()
set(_spice_glad_bld "${glad_BINARY_DIR}")
string(APPEND _spice_manifest
  "  \"glad\": {\n"
  "    \"resolved_via\": \"${_glad_resolved_via}\",\n"
)
string(APPEND _spice_manifest
  "    \"include_dirs\": [\"${_spice_glad_inc}\"],\n"
  "    \"link_dirs\":    [\"${_spice_glad_bld}\"],\n"
  "    \"link_libs\":    [\"glad\"]\n"
)
string(APPEND _spice_manifest "  }")

string(APPEND _spice_manifest "\n}\n")
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${_spice_manifest_path}" CONTENT "${_spice_manifest}")
message(STATUS "spice: will write cmake/spice-deps-manifest.json at generate time")
